title: Hiring & Offer Management
summary: Final interviews, decisions, automated offer letters, e-signatures and pre-onboarding.
headline: Close the hire *with confidence and speed*
lede: The final stretch of hiring is where great candidates are won or lost. TalentPool365 helps you run final interviews, make clear decisions, send offers and get new hires ready to start, all from one workspace.
sectionIntro: The final stretch of hiring is where great candidates are won or lost. TalentPool365 helps you run final interviews, make clear decisions, send offers and get new hires ready to start, all from one workspace.

capabilities.title: Final Interview Management
capabilities.tagline: Make the last round smooth for everyone.
capabilities.body: Coordinate final interviews with senior leaders and hiring managers without the scheduling chaos. Everyone gets the candidate’s full history before they walk in.
points: Schedule panel interviews with multiple interviewers
Complete candidate profile, scores and feedback in one view
Structured scorecards for final-round evaluation
Reminders for interviewers and candidates

capabilities.title: Hiring Decisions
capabilities.body: Bring screening, assessment, interview and feedback data together so your team can compare finalists fairly and agree on the best hire.
points: Side-by-side comparison of final candidates
Combined view of scores, interview results and team feedback
Record decisions and the reasons behind them
Approvals routed to the right decision-makers

capabilities.title: Offer Letter Generation
capabilities.body: Generate offer letters from approved templates, with candidate and role details filled in automatically. No more copy-pasting or manual edits that lead to errors.
points: Customizable offer letter templates
Auto-filled details such as role, salary, joining date and location
Approval step before an offer is released
Version history so changes are always tracked

capabilities.title: E-Signature Integration
capabilities.tagline: Get offers signed without the paperwork.
capabilities.body: Send offers digitally and let candidates sign from any device. You get faster acceptance, and everything is stored securely in the candidate’s record.
points: Send offers for e-signature directly from the platform
Candidates review and sign on mobile or desktop
Real-time status: sent, viewed, signed
Signed documents saved automatically to the candidate profile

capabilities.title: Pre-Onboarding
capabilities.tagline: Keep new hires excited between offer and day one.
capabilities.body: The gap between acceptance and joining is when offers fall through. Stay in touch with new hires, collect their documents and prepare them to start strong.
points: Digital collection of documents and joining forms
Checklists for HR, IT and hiring managers
Welcome messages and joining-day information
Reminders for pending tasks before the start date

outcomes.label: offer acceptance rate with digital e-signatures
pre-onboarding document completion before day one

closingCta.headline: From final interview to first day, all in one platform.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 helps you close hires faster and keep them.
